title: Mova
description: Read and act on org-mode todos through the Mova Android app: discover capture templates, search and read todos and the agenda through Mova's read-only provider, and create, complete, update, reschedule, or delete todos through mova:// links. Mova uses the server and credentials already configured in the app. Mova 7.1.1 or later runs native writes without another confirmation; EVA reports handoff, not verified completion.
guidance: Changing an existing todo takes two steps in the same request: find it, then change it. To complete, reschedule, update, delete, or open a todo, first call find_todos with the words the user used, or read_agenda when they mean today's or this week's items, and match their description to one row; if several fit, name them briefly and ask which. Then pass that row's id, or its file and pos when id is null, to the action instead of a paraphrased title. Turn relative dates such as tomorrow or next Friday into YYYY-MM-DD from the current time. To add a todo, use create_todo with a short title; call list_templates first only when the user names a kind of capture or the todo needs template-specific fields. A write receipt means Mova received the request, not that it applied it; check current state before any retry.
setup: Install Mova 7.1.1 or later for unattended native writes and sign in to the server you want EVA to use.
Expand this extension in Settings and choose Allow provider reads, which grants Mova's READ_TODOS permission on this device; without it the read actions report a setup rejection instead of rows.
Read rows are as fresh as Mova's active server; they say nothing about whether a later mova:// action succeeded.

tool.name: list_templates
tool.title: List capture templates
tool.description: Read capture templates from Mova's active server. Requires Mova login and Android READ_TODOS access granted in EVA extension settings. Use key as the template argument to create_todo or capture_todo. prompts_json lists the template's prompts as objects with name, type (string, date, tags, or body), and required; pass values for prompts other than the title and the universal fields through create_todo's prompts argument, keyed by prompt name. Results are bounded and may omit templates.

tool.name: find_todos
tool.title: Find todos
tool.description: Search todos on Mova's active server and return bounded rows. Requires Mova login and Android READ_TODOS access granted in EVA extension settings. Use a returned id in read_todo, open_todo, or a mutation in the same request; if id is null, use file, pos, and title with an intent action. q is passed to Mova's search. Only the requested page is searched; absence does not prove no todo exists.

tool.name: read_todo
tool.title: Read todo by id
tool.description: Read a todo with a known nonempty Org id from Mova's active server. Requires Mova login and Android READ_TODOS access granted in EVA extension settings. Use find_todos to discover ids. IDs must be a single path segment; todos without an id can be opened using file, pos, and title through open_todo.

id.description: Org id returned by find_todos or read_agenda; no slashes or dot segments.

tool.name: read_agenda
tool.title: Read agenda
tool.description: Read a bounded day or week agenda from Mova's active server. Requires Mova login and Android READ_TODOS access granted in EVA extension settings. Defaults are chosen by Mova when omitted. Use returned id, or file/pos/title when id is null, in a later intent action. This reads agenda rows; open_agenda opens Mova's UI.

date.description: Agenda date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for Mova's default date.

span.description: Agenda span. Mova defaults to day.

tool.name: create_todo
tool.title: Create todo
tool.description: Ask Mova 7.0.1 or later on Android to create a todo through a capture template. Title is required. Template selects a known Mova capture-template key; scheduled, deadline, priority, tags, and state are universal capture values. Body is used only when the chosen template declares a body prompt; other template prompts, as listed by list_templates, take their values from prompts. Mova 7.1.1 or later runs this native action without a confirmation sheet. A successful EVA receipt proves handoff only, not creation.

title.description: Heading text. Mova fills the template's first required string prompt with this value.

template.description: Known Mova capture-template key. When omitted, Mova uses the active server's default template, then default.

scheduled.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optionally followed by a space and an Org repeater such as +1w, ++1d, or .+2m.

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optionally followed by a space and an Org repeater such as +1w, ++1d, or .+2m.

priority.description: One priority letter, such as A.

state.description: Todo keyword sent verbatim, such as TODO or NEXT.

body.description: Body capture value. Mova's server applies it only when the selected template declares a body prompt.

prompts.description: Values for the selected template's other prompts, keyed by prompt name exactly as list_templates reports it. Date prompts take YYYY-MM-DD, tag prompts take comma-separated names, other prompts take text. Mova ignores names the template does not declare and refuses a capture that leaves a required prompt empty.

receipts.success: Todo creation request handed to Mova. The change is not verified by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova 7.0.1 or later is not installed or cannot handle todo creation.

tool.name: capture_todo
tool.title: Open typing capture
tool.description: Open Mova's Android typing capture dialog, optionally prefilled and with a known capture-template key selected. The user reviews or edits the text and submits in Mova. EVA observes only the handoff and does not receive the dialog result.

title.description: Optional text with which to prefill the typing dialog.

template.description: Known Mova capture-template key to select.

widgetId.description: Optional Android widget ID whose saved template is used when template is omitted.

receipts.success: Mova's typing capture dialog opened. Submission or cancellation is not observed by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova 7.0.1 or later is not installed or cannot open the typing capture dialog.

tool.name: capture_todo_voice
tool.title: Capture todo by voice
tool.description: Start Mova's Android voice-capture flow. Mova opens the system speech recognizer and automatically submits its first recognized phrase through the selected capture template. EVA observes only the activity handoff and does not receive success, failure, or cancellation data.

template.description: Known Mova capture-template key to select.

widgetId.description: Optional Android widget ID whose saved template is used when template is omitted.

receipts.success: Mova's voice-capture flow opened. Recognition and todo creation are not verified by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova 7.0.1 or later is not installed or cannot start voice capture.

tool.name: complete_todo
tool.title: Complete todo
tool.description: Ask Mova 7.0.1 or later on Android to set a todo's state, DONE by default. Identify it by id; otherwise use file and pos, with title as an optional disambiguator; exact title alone is also accepted through the server's fallback lookup. Date backdates completion as YYYY-MM-DD. strict=true forbids server fallback lookups. Mova 7.1.1 or later runs this native action without a confirmation sheet. A successful EVA receipt proves handoff only.

id.description: Org ID property. Takes precedence over other references.

file.description: Absolute Org file path returned by Mova or its server. Use together with pos.

pos.description: Integer buffer position returned by Mova or its server. Use together with file.

title.description: Optional exact-title disambiguator, or a title-only fallback reference.

state.description: Todo keyword sent verbatim. Mova defaults to DONE when omitted.

date.description: Optional completion date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

strict.description: True forbids the server's fallback lookups.

receipts.success: Todo completion request handed to Mova. The change is not verified by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova 7.0.1 or later is not installed or cannot handle todo completion.

tool.name: update_todo
tool.title: Update todo
tool.description: Ask Mova 7.0.1 or later on Android to update a todo. Identify it by id; otherwise use file and pos, with title as an optional disambiguator; exact title alone is also accepted through the server's fallback lookup. Supply at least one of new_title, scheduled, deadline, priority, tags, state, or body. An empty scheduled, deadline, priority, tags, state, or body value clears that field. strict=true forbids server fallback lookups. Mova 7.1.1 or later runs this native action without a confirmation sheet. A successful EVA receipt proves handoff only.

id.description: Org ID property. Takes precedence over other references.

file.description: Absolute Org file path returned by Mova or its server. Use together with pos.

pos.description: Integer buffer position returned by Mova or its server. Use together with file.

title.description: Optional exact-title disambiguator, or a title-only fallback reference.

new_title.description: Replacement heading text. title remains the reference field.

scheduled.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optionally followed by an Org repeater; empty clears the scheduled timestamp.

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optionally followed by an Org repeater; empty clears the deadline.

priority.description: One priority letter, such as A; empty clears priority.

tags.description: Comma-separated tag names; empty removes all tags.

state.description: Todo keyword sent verbatim; empty clears state.

body.description: Replacement todo body; empty clears it.

strict.description: True forbids the server's fallback lookups.

receipts.success: Todo update request handed to Mova. The change is not verified by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova 7.0.1 or later is not installed or cannot handle todo updates.

tool.name: reschedule_todo
tool.title: Reschedule todo
tool.description: Ask Mova 7.0.1 or later on Android to set or clear a todo's scheduled and deadline timestamps through the reschedule alias. Identify it by id; otherwise use file and pos, with title as an optional disambiguator; exact title alone is also accepted through the server's fallback lookup. Supply scheduled, deadline, or both. An empty value clears that timestamp. strict=true forbids server fallback lookups. Mova 7.1.1 or later runs this native action without a confirmation sheet. A successful EVA receipt proves handoff only.

id.description: Org ID property. Takes precedence over other references.

file.description: Absolute Org file path returned by Mova or its server. Use together with pos.

pos.description: Integer buffer position returned by Mova or its server. Use together with file.

title.description: Optional exact-title disambiguator, or a title-only fallback reference.

scheduled.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optionally followed by an Org repeater; empty clears the scheduled timestamp.

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optionally followed by an Org repeater; empty clears the deadline.

strict.description: True forbids the server's fallback lookups.

receipts.success: Todo reschedule request handed to Mova. The change is not verified by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova 7.0.1 or later is not installed or cannot handle rescheduling.

tool.name: delete_todo
tool.title: Delete todo
tool.description: Ask Mova 7.0.1 or later on Android to permanently delete a todo and its sub-headings. Identify it by id or by file and pos; title may be included as a disambiguator. Mova 7.1.1 or later runs this native action without a confirmation sheet. A successful EVA receipt proves handoff only, not deletion.

id.description: Org ID property. Takes precedence over other references.

file.description: Absolute Org file path returned by Mova or its server. Use together with pos.

pos.description: Integer buffer position returned by Mova or its server. Use together with file.

title.description: Optional exact-title disambiguator; title alone is not a valid delete reference.

receipts.success: Todo deletion request handed to Mova. The change is not verified by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova 7.0.1 or later is not installed or cannot handle todo deletion.

tool.name: open_todo
tool.title: Open todo
tool.description: Open a todo's edit screen in the Android Mova app. Identify it by id or by file and pos; title may be included as a disambiguator. Mova shows an alert when no matching todo is found. EVA observes only the app handoff.

id.description: Org ID property. Takes precedence over other references.

file.description: Absolute Org file path returned by Mova or its server. Use together with pos.

pos.description: Integer buffer position returned by Mova or its server. Use together with file.

title.description: Optional exact-title disambiguator; title alone is not a documented open reference.

receipts.success: Todo reference handed to Mova. Whether the edit screen found and opened the todo is not verified by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova is not installed or cannot open this todo reference.

tool.name: search_todos
tool.title: Open todo search
tool.description: Open the Android Mova app's search tab, optionally prefilled with a query. This navigates the app and does not return todo data to EVA.

receipts.success: Search view handed to Mova. Search results are not returned to EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova is not installed or cannot open todo search.

tool.name: open_agenda
tool.title: Open agenda
tool.description: Open the Android Mova app's agenda on an optional date and day or week span. This navigates the app and does not return agenda data to EVA.

receipts.success: Agenda view handed to Mova. Agenda entries are not returned to EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova is not installed or cannot open the agenda.

tool.name: refresh
tool.title: Refresh Mova data
tool.description: Ask Mova 7.0.1 or later on Android to drop its query caches and redraw agenda widgets. git=true also asks the active org-agenda server to pull its Org repositories first. Mova runs this native action without a confirmation sheet. EVA observes only the activity handoff and cannot verify cache refresh or git pull completion.

git.description: True also requests a server-side git pull before refreshing.

receipts.success: Refresh request handed to Mova. Cache invalidation and any requested git pull are not verified by EVA.
receipts.handlerMissing: Mova 7.0.1 or later is not installed or cannot handle refresh requests.
